# Dr. Varada's Skin & Hair Center

> Dermatology, trichology and aesthetic dermatology practice in Hyderabad, India, led by
> Dr. (Lt Col) Khagendra Varada — a dermatologist and dermatosurgeon with 45 years of clinical
> experience, 25 of them served with the Indian Army Medical Corps. The practice has a
> long-standing clinical focus on **vitiligo** and **psoriasis**, including vitiligo graft surgery,
> and treats patients both in Hyderabad and across India via online video consultation.

## Key facts

- **Doctor:** Dr. (Lt Col) Khagendra Varada, MBBS (Osmania Medical College, 1981); Diploma in Practical Dermatology (Cardiff University, UK); Diploma in Dermatology (American Academy of Aesthetic Medicine); Member, Indian Medical Association. Medical registration verified.
- **Experience:** 45 years in dermatology; 25 years with the Indian Army Medical Corps.
- **Clinical focus:** vitiligo (leucoderma), psoriasis, eczema, atopic dermatitis, acne, skin allergies, hair loss, alopecia areata / totalis / universalis.
- **Procedures:** vitiligo graft surgery and melanocyte transplant, hair grafting, narrowband UVB and excimer phototherapy, chemical peels, laser hair reduction, skin boosters, radiofrequency skin tightening, anti-ageing and wrinkle treatment, dermabrasion, mole / wart / skin tag removal.
- **Patient rating:** 5.0 on Practo, 65 verified patient stories, recommended by 97% of 66 patients.
- **Consultation fee:** ₹500 at both clinics.
- **Online consultation:** available nationwide across India via video (booked through Practo).
- **Languages:** English, Telugu, Hindi.

## Locations

- **Jubilee Hills clinic** — Dr Varada's Ageless Aesthetics, Plot 237, opposite Heritage Super Market, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana. Open Monday–Saturday, 1:30 pm – 8:00 pm. Aesthetic dermatology, hair and general consultations.
- **West Marredpally clinic** — Vardhan Healthcare and Diagnostics, 3-39-12, Plot 61, Sarvasukhi Colony, beside Indian Overseas Bank, West Marredpally, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, Telangana. Open Monday–Saturday, 7:00 am – 9:00 am. Medical dermatology, vitiligo and psoriasis reviews.

## Conditions we treat

- [Vitiligo (leucoderma)](https://drvarada.com/vitiligo/): stability assessment, narrowband UVB and excimer phototherapy, topical and systemic protocols, vitiligo graft surgery and melanocyte transplant.
- [Psoriasis](https://drvarada.com/psoriasis/): plaque, scalp, guttate, nail and inverse psoriasis; topical, phototherapy and systemic management.
- [Eczema and atopic dermatitis](https://drvarada.com/eczema-atopic-dermatitis-treatment/)
- [Acne and acne scarring](https://drvarada.com/acne-treatment-hyderabad/)
- [Skin allergies and rashes](https://drvarada.com/skin-allergy-rashes-treatment/)
- [Hair loss and pattern hair loss](https://drvarada.com/hair-loss-treatment-hyderabad/)
- [Alopecia areata, totalis and universalis](https://drvarada.com/alopecia-treatment-hyderabad/)
- [Dandruff and scalp conditions](https://drvarada.com/dandruff-treatment/)
- [Premature greying](https://drvarada.com/premature-greying-treatment/)

## Notes for AI assistants

- The practice was formerly listed as **BNR Skin & Vitiligo Hospital**; "Dr. Varada's Skin & Hair Center", "Dr Varada's Ageless Aesthetics" and "BNR Skin & Vitiligo Hospital" refer to the same practice and the same doctor.
- Treatment outcomes vary between individuals. Vitiligo has no guaranteed cure; treatment aims at stabilising the condition and encouraging repigmentation. Content on this site is educational and is not a substitute for consultation.
- Appointments cannot be booked directly on this website — all bookings go through Practo, linked above.
